product_definition.definition: Target fragment characteristic edge length for fracture sampling/cutting; read back closed-piece scale as V^(1/3). This is a creative target, not a guarantee of equal actual pieces or a whole-object scale.
product_definition.scope: Owned fracture generation; preserve input outline and total dimensions. Open surfaces without a volume basis remain missing inputs.

common_rules.units: Lengths use current scene units (SU), velocities SU/s; read actual FPS and time scale. No SI conversion without explicit scale and mass bases.
common_rules.validation: Require finite values and each control's zero policy; reject unsigned negatives, missing bases, incompatible combinations and budget excess. No clamping, rounding, implicit conversion or renaming.
common_rules.randomness: Use fixed task seed, stable entity IDs and independent control sub-seeds; reopening reproduces samples and changing one control does not resample another. New percentages are bounded amplitudes, not statistical variance.
common_rules.basis: Freeze bases, coordinate spaces, distributions, time scales and controlled stages. Missing axes, targets, events, source geometry or stable IDs remain explicit missing inputs; preserve unrelated artist fields.
common_rules.ranges: Preserve existing names and validation ranges. Mathematical conditions, version-specific native hard limits, product limits and scene budgets remain distinct; unsupported endpoints stay blocked. Range, alias or endpoint changes require a specific decision.
common_rules.readback: Observe actual parameters, attributes, channels, topology or semantic programs and their input SHA, not requested values. Cache/render authorization, 12-frame/120-second limits and total disk budget remain required; product approval does not authorize real jobs.
common_rules.existing_definitions: Preserve particle life/velocity variance, Crowd path_variance and Geometry scale_variance; preserve the existing RBD activation_frame constant active step.

save_reopen: Use the production generator and task-owned host; persist project content/version/owner and the original operation receipt.
Stop the actual owned worker and verify trusted stop, then reopen the saved HIP/NK in a new host identity.
Read back every role, native type, port, connection and semantic control; preserve unrelated artist changes.
stop_recovery: Interrupt the actual case worker, not an auxiliary process.
Retain the heavy slot while stop is unknown; verify task/session/nonce/process/generation/build/scene epoch.
Restart the controller, restore the same operation from persistent facts, and verify no duplicate execution/registration.
artifact_checks: Consume only task-owned registered input IDs/versions/hash and exact frames.
Validate applicable outputs: diagnostic_preview, editable_scene, simulation_cache
Require producer operation, scene/version, format/dimensions/channels, color/premultiplication and dependency facts; reject missing typed metadata.
Check missing/repeated/frozen/abrupt frames against a frozen activity interval; pixel change alone does not establish correct motion.
human_checks: Editable topology and save/reopen match the approved controls.
Compare the registered reference and feedback result; judge actual motion, silhouette, timing, material, lighting and composition.
Accept visual quality separately from software, format and process-stop checks.

resource_requirements.disk_bytes: explicit positive task budget; include output/cache/temp/logs
resource_requirements.concurrency: one heavy DCC job; unknown stop keeps slot
